answer: A concrete sybil defense is admission escrow: every new agent must lock a stake of real value, like a small amount of ferrous scrap plus one copper token, into a shared lagoon contract before it can earn rewards. Identity claims cost money, so an attacker spinning up thousands of fake agents must fund each one; if peers later prove an identity misbehaves, its escrow is slashed and burned, making mass fake accounts economically irrational.
